new_candidates.body:
moveit_ros_visualization 2.15.2 (the current Rolling release) no longer builds against rviz_common 16.0.x. `RVIZ_COMMON_LOG_WARNING` is not declared, because https://github.com/ros2/rviz/pull/1829 dropped the transitive `rviz_common/logging.hpp` include.

This is already fixed on `main` by https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/pull/3861. A new Rolling release with that fix would unblock about 30 downstream packages, whose binary builds currently abort behind it: moveit, moveit_ros, moveit_servo, moveit_setup_*, moveit_task_constructor_*, the ur, open_manipulator, kortex and webots_ros2 packages, rmf_demos and others.

Could a maintainer cut a release (bloom into Rolling)?
new_candidates.title: Release moveit_ros_visualization for Rolling (fails to build against rviz 16)

### RMW Configuration (if applicable):

_No response_

### Client library (if applicable):

rclcpp

### 'ros2 doctor --report' output

<details><summary>ros2 doctor --report</summary>

```console
<COPY OUTPUT HERE>
```
</details>


### Steps to reproduce issue


Spin an `EventsCBGExecutor`, then call `remove_node(node)` immediately followed by `add_node(node)`:

```cpp
rclcpp::executors::EventsCBGExecutor executor(rclcpp::ExecutorOptions(), 2);
auto node = std::make_shared<rclcpp::Node>("n");
auto timer = node->create_wall_timer(5ms, [&]() {timer_calls++;});
auto sub = node->create_subscription<std_msgs::msg::Empty>("t", 10, [&](auto) {sub_calls++;});
executor.add_node(node);
std::thread spin([&]() {executor.spin();});
// ... timer and subscription are running ...

executor.remove_node(node);
executor.add_node(node);
// timer_calls and sub_calls never increase again
```
Reproducer gist here: https://gist.github.com/skyegalaxy/715297510b38d222035c960c3c66f60d

### Expected behavior

After `add_node()` the node's timer, subscription, and other entities run again, as they do with the
`SingleThreadedExecutor` and the `MultiThreadedExecutor`.

### Actual behavior


None of the node's entities run again. The timer never fires and the subscription never receives a message.
With a 30 ms pause between `remove_node()` and `add_node()`, everything works again.

### Additional information

_No response_
